node.title: Re: PerlIO::gzip can't handle appended stuff
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
AFAICT from [https://rt.cpan.org/Public/Bug/Display.html?id=90480|Bug #90480], I think [mod://PerlIO::gzip] may not support this. I usually use the core modules IO::Compress::* and IO::Uncompress::*. Their objects can also be used like filehandles - this works for me:

use IO::Uncompress::Gunzip (); my $in = IO::Uncompress::Gunzip->new('tst.gz', MultiStream=>1 ) or die "$IO::Uncompress::Gunzip::GunzipError"; print while <$in>; close $in;
